info.title: Historical Exchange Rate API Reference
info.description: Get exchange rates for a specific historical date for any base currency. Returns rates for all available currencies or a filtered set of symbols. Supports fiat, crypto, and metals. Accepts a date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Returns a 400 error for a missing/malformed date and a 404 error for unsupported currencies, symbols, or a date with no available data.

get.description: Returns exchange rates for a specific historical date.

parameters.name: base
parameters.description: Base currency code. Defaults to `USD`. Supports fiat, crypto, and metals.

parameters.name: symbols
parameters.description: Comma-separated currency codes. Omit to get all available rates.

400.description: Bad Request — Missing or malformed date

invalidDateFormat.summary: date is not in YYYY-MM-DD format

value.message: Provided Date 10-01-2025 is in invalid format. It should be like  YYYY-MM-DD!

404.description: Not found - Currency, symbol, or date not available

dateNotFound.summary: No data for the given date

value.message: Rates of provided date 2099-01-01 are not available in our database.
Rates of provided currency ZZZ are not available in our database!
Rates of provided Symbols are not available in our database!

ApiKeyAuthHeader.name: X-apiKey
ApiKeyAuthHeader.description: Pass your API key via the X-apiKey request header.

ApiKeyAuthQuery.name: apiKey
ApiKeyAuthQuery.description: Pass your API key via the apiKey query parameter.

HistoricalExchangeRatesResponse.description: Historical exchange rate response containing date, base currency, and rates map.

base.description: Base currency used for calculating exchange rates.

rates.description: Map of currency codes to their exchange rate against the base currency on the requested date. Each key is a currency code and the value is an exchange rate string.

additionalProperties.title: ExchangeRateString
additionalProperties.description: Exchange rate value as a string for this currency code.

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error envelope returned by the API on failed requests. Gateway-level validation errors use an ISO 8601 timestamp and the public endpoint path; currency-service errors (date/symbol validation) use a Unix millisecond timestamp and an internal service path instead.

error.description: Short error category or exception type (e.g., Invalid Param Exception, Not Found Exception).

message.description: Human-readable error message describing the failure.

path.description: API endpoint path (gateway errors) or internal service path (currency-service errors) that produced the error.

status.description: HTTP status code returned with the error.

timestamp.description: Timestamp when the error occurred — ISO 8601 string for gateway errors, Unix milliseconds integer for currency-service errors.
